content.short: Onramp.money is a fast and secure fiat-to-crypto conversion service enabling users to enter Web3 in under 60 seconds on Mantle.
content.description: Onramp.money is a fast and user-friendly fiat-to-cryptocurrency on-ramp platform that enables users to purchase crypto assets using bank transfers and UPI payments in key markets in under 60 seconds. The service is integrated with Mantle Network, allowing new users to acquire MNT and other Mantle assets directly with fiat currency, significantly lowering the barrier to first-time blockchain participation.
content.meta: Onramp.money enables secure fiat-to-crypto conversion in under 60 seconds for Mantle users. Discover Onramp.money on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
